description: This file defines a Razor ViewComponent for displaying the shopping basket in an ASP.NET Core MVC e-commerce web application. It manages retrieving the number of items in the basket for signed-in and anonymous users, utilizing services and authentication mechanisms.

classes.name: Basket
classes.description: A Razor ViewComponent responsible for rendering the shopping basket summary, including item count, depending on user sign-in status.

methods.name: InvokeAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves the total number of items in the user's basket and returns the corresponding view component result.

methods.name: CountTotalBasketItems
methods.description: Determines the total basket items count for the current user or anonymous session.

methods.name: GetAnnonymousIdFromCookie
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve the anonymous basket identifier from cookies.
